description: This Java class 'TSProjectConsumer' handles reading, processing, and writing configuration files for TunerStudio, including managing file sections and integrating variable substitutions.

classes.name: TSProjectConsumer
classes.description: A class responsible for consuming and processing configuration files for TunerStudio, including reading, writing, and handling structural end events.

methods.description: Initialization method called at the start of file processing (empty implementation).
